description: Synthetic support tickets written for this smoke test. Not customer data or a held-out accuracy evaluation.

items.text: A customer needs a PDF invoice for last month's subscription payment.
After resetting their password, a user is repeatedly signed out on their phone. Old session credentials are still cached.
The monthly subscription was charged twice. The customer requests a refund for the duplicate payment.
The password reset email never arrives. The customer cannot access the reset link.
A customer moved house and wants future packages sent to a different delivery address.
An exported CSV drops accented letters from contact names. The original records display correctly.
A customer asks to cancel automatic subscription renewal at the end of the current month.
A delivery is late. Tracking has not updated for three days, but the delivery address is correct.

cases.question: Which ticket describes being logged out after changing a password?
Who needs money returned because they paid twice?
Which customer needs their shipping destination changed?
Which ticket is about corrupted characters when downloading a spreadsheet?
Which ticket reports an overheating laptop battery?
